messages.subj: OpenOS demo cut — dock magnification looks great
messages.body:
Watched the latest capture twice.

The dock magnification curve finally feels like the real thing — springy but not rubbery. Two notes:

1. Genie minimize reads great at 0.4s. Don't speed it up.
2. Spotlight results could show the app icon a touch larger.

Approving this cut for the bench run.

messages.subj: Probe matrix updated for spec v0
messages.body:
The frozen probe matrix for spec v0 is live:

• apps render: headless E2E across all 12+ apps
• interaction probes: 15 (drag, resize, spotlight-launch, rename, trash-restore, theme-persist…)
• persistence across reload
• security probe: /etc/shadow → 403
• human fidelity pass

Good luck tonight.

Reviewed the sandbox path resolver.

Absolute paths outside the allow-list return 403, symlink escapes are realpath-checked, and writes can't traverse above the root. One suggestion: keep the 403 (not 404) semantics so probes can distinguish "blocked" from "missing".

LGTM.

Salut!

Small change: we swap segment 4 (Claude vs OpenClaw) with the autoresearch piece — guest prefers that order.

Rundown attached, same 7 segments otherwise.

Bisous,
Chloé

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday.

The belief-substrate angle is the interesting part — partners want to see how coherence edges differ from plain RAG retrieval. Can you send the one-pager before Thursday?
